- `getFogMaskForImage()` accepts optional `uploadsDir`; calls `repairImageDimensions` before `createMask` when dims are 0x0
- `flushAllFogCaches(db)` exported — cancels all timers and saves every cached mask to DB
- `close` handler: on GM disconnect, flushes all pending saves immediately (fire-and-forget async)
- `createWsHandlers(db, uploadsDir?)` threads `uploadsDir` through all `getFogMaskForImage` calls

**`src/index.ts`** — passes `uploadsDir` to `createWsHandlers`; registers `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` handlers that call `flushAllFogCaches` before exit

**`public/js/canvas.ts`** — `applyFogMask()`: when mask header has 0x0, logs a warning and falls back to `imgW`/`imgH` instead of bailing (only truly bails if no image is loaded yet)

**`test/ws/handler.test.ts`** — added "Fog mask survives flush" and "Fog mask persists across GM reconnection"

**`test/fog/serialize.test.ts`** — added round-trip with exact pixel values test and 0x0 header graceful fallback test
